# Contributing

Please open an issue before changing the measured configuration. Include the image digest, checkpoint provenance, hardware, driver, exact command and a sanitized result record. For a performance claim, provide step time, accepted length, prompt/output shape, cache state, repeats and a control run. For a quality claim, include the item manifest, scorer and seeds. Preserve upstream Apache notices in derived files. By submitting, you agree your contribution is licensed under Apache-2.0, as described in [LICENSE](../LICENSE).
